title: Mixed Results, Moderately Impressive
text:
Mixed Results, Moderately Impressive. Unless your mirrors are spotless and you're really just wiping off steam. . . and even if it's just steam for that matter you're going to need a few paper towels or an old terrycloth towel around to clean up the drips and wipe of the blade and mirror as you go.
What I've found, because my car lacks a rear wiper and has a spoiler the combined shapes coat the rear window with dust and water drops faster than you can believe. Also requiring an old towel I've found keeping this inside the garage to wipe off the back, side and side-view mirrors quickly after being out in the rain or with a spray or three of glass cleaner if it'd been dusty a far handier tool than in the bathroom.
I think this works far better on the car than the bathroom mirrors where it did a fair, if somewhat messy job.
